# Olist E-commerce - Key Findings (auto-generated; rewrite in your own words)

1. **Delivery vs satisfaction (strong link).** On-time orders average 4.29 stars; orders 8+ days late average 1.70
   (79% are 1-2 star vs 9% when on time). 6.7% of delivered orders arrive after the estimate.
2. **Repeat purchasing is the weak spot.** 3.0% of customers ordered more than once; one-time buyers generate 94.5% of revenue.
3. **Revenue concentration.** health_beauty is #1 (9.3% of revenue); the top 3 categories make up 25.9%.
4. **Regional logistics gap.** AL has the highest late rate (21.4%) vs AM (2.8%).
5. **Payments.** credit_card accounts for the largest share of payment value.

## Recommendations to investigate (edit these)
- Improve delivery-date promises/carrier performance in the worst states; set realistic ETAs - lateness costs ratings.
- Review the sellers with the highest late rates (see seller_scorecard) for coaching or removal.
- Repeat purchase rate is 3.0%: judge whether a post-purchase retention test (email/voucher after delivery) is worth running.
- Check whether high-revenue categories are also the late-delivery or low-review ones.

## Limitations
Observational data: late delivery and low scores are associated, not proven causal. Cohort months with few customers are noisy.
